cues: This is an ovule, the megasporangium, cut lengthwise.
It hangs from the placenta by a stalk, the funicle, which joins the body at the hilum.
text: Now the female side. This is an ovule, the megasporangium, cut lengthwise. It hangs from the placenta by a stalk, the funicle, which joins the body at the hilum.
